description: When an agent pane may switch to another harness, shared by the Mac (HarnessSwitchModel.canSwitch) and the desktop client (soyeht_client::switch::can_switch). `agent` is `none` (the pane has no agent session), `idle` or `configuring` (a configuration change is in flight); `switch` is the phase of the pane's last switch, if any.

canSwitch.name: an idle agent pane of a connected client can switch
a switch that restarted the pane does not block another
a switch that failed does not block another
a pane cannot switch while the client is disconnected
a pane cannot switch while a configuration change is in flight
a pane cannot switch while a switch is running
a pane with no agent session cannot switch
a disconnected pane that is configuring cannot switch
